page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at the top. Page number at the top right. One marginal note in the right margin, beside the paragraph "7. 4. Arminius ait". Small ornamental marks in the right margin near lines 16 and 18 are not printed text. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: pudfe[?]. Decerno ut Adamus & posteri ipsius salventur, siquidem legem præstiterint, vel si non, ut salventur siquidem crediderint, vel si nulli crediderint, ut damnentur: hic Deus fuit anceps, pendulus & decretis figendis varius, pendens plane in decretis suis æternis à temporariis hominum actibus. 3. Fecit decretum euangelicum vel præsciens quosdam creditu-ros, vel non præsciens: si primum, tum decretum de certis quibusdam personis salvan-dis, erit prius decreto generali de salvandis fidelibus, quod invertit decretorum Armi-nianum ordinem: si posterius, Deus nulla providentia, quia nulla scientia, fecit totum euangelium, & ignoravit in eo decreto utrum assequeretur illustrationem gloriæ misericordiæ, vel justitiæ. 4. Quare fecit Deus decretum legale non peremptorium? certe vel quia præscivit Adamum lapsurum, & sic quare omnino fecit, quod abrogandum fore, & incas-so[?] fine futurum prævidit? id enim non est scientis, præscito fine frustraneo, aliquid facere, vel fecit non peremptorium, quia non præ-scivit, sed conjecturam fecit, fieri posse, ut homo, qui est creatura mutabilis, peccet; & sic non opus fuit in eo signo rationis decreto legali, quorsum decerneret, quod refigendum sit?

7. 4. Arminius ait; Certum est Deum velle non-nulla, quæ non vellet, nisi aliqua humana volitio antecederet. Atqui humanæ omnes volitiones sunt temporaneæ, & vult alibi, neminem esse actu reprobum nisi reipsa existentem, & sic repro-Antiperk. p. 750. edit. Bertii.

page.notes: Running head first letters are small capitals and the first word is hard to read: "ILMVTABIL" is a best reading. The first word of the page, "pudfe", is a fragment of a word cut off at the top of the column and is uncertain. "incas-so" at the line end is doubtful; the word is printed with a long s that looks like f. The marks in the right margin near lines 16 and 18 look like printer's reference marks or ornaments; they are not transcribed. The last word "repro-" is a catchword at the foot of the page.
